description: Humanitarian aid pallets rigged with parachutes for airdrop aboard a C-130J Super Hercules are loaded and prepared for takeoff at an undisclosed location in Southwest Asia, March 1, 2024. The humanitarian assistance included 38,000 Meals Ready to Eat to alleviate suffering of civilians in Gaza. (U.S. Air Force Courtesy photo)
